essence: Such sights necessitate a prescribed act of purification.
Purification requires a clothed bath accompanied by seeing the sun and remembering Viṣṇu.
Even practitioners of low conduct can be purified by observing a three-day vow.
A person in remembrance should perform a bath while remaining clothed.
Twice-born brāhmaṇas should be purified by observing a three-day vow.
